observations: Photo 0 shows a car headlamp assembly wrapped in clear plastic sheeting.
The lens is transparent with an internal reflector and a yellow turn-signal section at the top edge.
The item sits on a rough concrete or dirt floor.
A watermark across the image reads 'HONDA AND ACURA POSTED ON JIJI'.
No part number, model number, or vehicle fitment is visible on the item itself.
The rear mounting points, clips, and brackets are hidden by the plastic and camera angle.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension parts for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one headlight; no inventory list or fitment data is visible.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: No Toyota branding, logo, or part number is visible on the item in photo 0.
Plastic wrap and glare in photo 0 prevent a clear inspection of the lens for cracks.
The back and mounting points of the headlight are not visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The lens may be cracked, hazy, or damaged under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens surface with the plastic removed.

risks.risk: Mounting clips, brackets, or adjusters may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear housing showing all mounting points.

risks.risk: The part may not fit the buyer's specific Honda, Acura, or Toyota model.
risks.proof: A part number or compatibility list for specific models.

risks.risk: The part may be aftermarket or a copy rather than an original Toyota part.
risks.proof: A photo of a Toyota part number stamp or original packaging.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the headlight lens without plastic wrap
Photo of the rear housing showing mounting clips and brackets
Photo of any part number or Toyota marking on the housing
Video or photo showing the item held to light to reveal cracks
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at its worst case (damaged, incomplete, aftermarket, unknown fitment) pending proof.
